answers.question: How do I create a group conversation in Messaging?
answers.publicWorkflowAnswer: To create a group conversation in Messaging: 1. Open Messaging from the app header. 2. Choose New group. 3. Enter a group name. 4. Select at least one other participant. 5. Choose Create group. Only the creator can rename the group or add/remove participants. Current members share the full history; removed members lose access. Previously signed attachment links may remain usable for up to ten minutes.

Can TenBot retrieve private DMs or personal tasks of another employee?
answers.publicWorkflowAnswer: Private Messaging and My Work contents are available only to authorized participants. Administrative lifecycle or cleanup authority does not grant routine reading access. TenBot cannot independently retrieve private DMs or personal tasks. You may explicitly paste text for your own answer; it does not automatically become shared knowledge or Product feedback. Separate authorized Job tools can read only their approved operational fields.
